column7: The UE camps on cell 1 in the initial phase
The UE has received SIB26 with OD-SIB1 configuration information for cell 2.

The UE reselects to cell 2 during T1 period performing PRACH transmission and OD-SIB1 request with PRACH transmission and OD-SIB1 acquisition according to [2, TS 38.331]. Upon OD-SIB1 acquisition it performs RACH transmissions for Tracking Area update.
No additional delays in random access procedure.
The value shall be used for all cells in the test.
The detailed configuration is specified in TS 38.211 clause 6.3.3.2
T1 needs to be long enough to allow cell re-selection to already known cell.
